title: SecurityProgram
description: Cross-axis Oyatie security program: threat model, security posture controls, per-axis controls, and continuous control monitoring. Retired from docs/SECURITY-PROGRAM.md per specs/markdown-retirement-policy.json.

_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable security program: threat model, posture controls, and per-axis control catalog for continuous-control-monitoring evidence cadence.
_meta.provenance: Converted from docs/SECURITY-PROGRAM.md (Draft v0.1, 2026-05-09) with founder-directed de-staling 2026-07-03: retire the stale legacy AI-runtime-axis vocabulary to the intelligence substrate naming (cloud-intelligence + oya/intelligence), correct stack-posture claims to the owned-Rust destination + transitional-adapter-behind-ports framing, correct authorization claims to the cloud-iam PDP, drop retired issue-tracker citations, and drop citations to ADRs absent from this checkout (ADR-0037).

threat_model.assumption: The Oyatie threat model assumes: a sophisticated, motivated adversary with credentials to one tenant; a supply-chain attacker who has compromised a transitive dep; an insider with elevated access to one axis; a regulator who can subpoena. Defense-in-depth across all 7 axes.

threat_actors.mitigations: mTLS + per-cell isolation + audit chain + owned supply-chain gates (transitional scanning/signing tooling behind ports, ADR-0039 lineage) + signed commits
Per-tenant cell isolation + KMS-shred + immutable backups + DR drills
cloud-iam PDP policy (Cedar policy engine; fail-closed, server-side decide()) + break-glass audit + foundation-bypass ledger + CODEOWNERS
M-of-N approval for high-risk ops + dry-run + rollback + audit
Autonomy ceiling + per-capability data-class allowlist + evidence emission + sandbox
Engine-enforced row-level security per ADR-0006 + cell isolation + per-class data boundary
Wasmtime sandbox per ADR-0023 (transitional-adapter class) + cap-gated PluginContext + owned supply-chain signing gates (transitional signing tooling behind ports, ADR-0039 lineage)
Trust portal + per-tenant proof-of-erasure + jurisdictional minimization

threat_actors.actor: State actor (KR / JP / US / EU / IN / etc.)
threat_actors.mitigations: Per-region data residency + per-pack regulator binding + transparent reporting

attack_surfaces.surface: Mail SMTP / IMAP receive; Doc CRDT; Drive object download; Meet WebRTC
attack_surfaces.top_threats: Phishing; XSS in Doc; permission escalation; recording leak
Vertical-specific (PHI exfil, payment fraud, contract breach)

attack_surfaces.surface: Provider adapter (subscription cookies) across cloud-intelligence + oya/intelligence capability surfaces; capability invocation; tool sandbox
attack_surfaces.top_threats: Subscription token theft; capability misuse; sandbox escape; prompt injection (taint zones)

attack_surfaces.surface: IAM; KMS; tenant compute; storage; network
attack_surfaces.top_threats: IAM enumeration; key compromise; cell breach; lateral movement
Crawl-rate abuse; index poisoning; PII leak via query log
Click fraud; targeting bypass; advertiser-data exfil

security_posture_controls.statement: Defense-in-depth across all 7 axes. Every cross-axis call must pass: identity check, RBAC/ABAC, data-class gate, cell-routing, audit emission.
Zero trust between cells, between tenants, between axes — no implicit trust.
mTLS everywhere on the owned service-mesh posture (transitional mesh adapters behind stable ports per ADR-0510; owned Rust destination); service-to-service has authenticated peer.
KMS-shred encryption at rest per ADR-0043 envelope encryption; per-record DEK for HARD_DENY classes.
Per-cell isolation evidence with quarterly cross-tenant negative-access fuzz.
Owned supply-chain gates (license-policy, supply-chain-audit, SBOM emission) with transitional scanning/signing tooling behind ports (ADR-0039 lineage); license-policy gate per drafted ADR.
Branch-protection-as-code; admission policy via the owned pipeline/cloud-k8s admission gates (single required context presubmit per ADR-0515).
Audit-chain emission per ADR-0003 with 4-hour evidence-pack regeneration SLA.
Break-glass for every regulated capability; M-of-N approval (3-of-5 for catastrophic) + automated revoke after window.
Quarterly red team + annual external pen test per PCI-DSS Req 11 + ISO 27001 control set.

saas: Per-tenant cell isolation with engine-enforced RLS (ADR-0006)
Authorization decisions via the cloud-iam PDP (Cedar policy engine behind the PDP port; fail-closed, server-side decide()) on every API call
workspace: Mail DLP + phishing classifier + sandboxed attachment scan
Doc per-permission granular share via the cloud-iam PDP (Cedar policy engine)
Meet recording access only via trust portal with audit
Workspace data-class respects tenant-class override (HIPAA Mail, PCI off, education-minor blocks)
vertical: Per-vertical regulator binding (HIPAA / MFDS / FSC / PIPA / GDPR …)
Per-vertical hard-deny override (healthcare PHI, fintech PCI, education minors)
Per-vertical control evidence emission (HIPAA controls, KISA controls, etc.)
intelligence: Per-capability data-class allowlist + cloud-iam PDP gate (Cedar policy engine)
Tool sandbox: Wasmtime default (transitional-adapter class), Firecracker for higher-isolation (transitional-adapter class)
Prompt-injection taint zones (untrusted content marked; downstream tools refuse)
M-of-N break-glass for autonomy-tier T4 (auto-execute) operations
cloud: IAM via cloud-iam PDP (Cedar policy engine) + STS short-lived credentials; no long-lived API keys (OIDC)
KMS HSM-backed (KCMVP for KR per ADR-0043)
Per-cell network ACLs; no implicit east-west traffic
IMDSv2 enforcement on all VMs; no IMDSv1 fallback
WORM tier for compliance archives (Glacier-class with vault lock)
search: Crawl politeness + per-host budget; rate-limit per crawl-rights ledger
SERP query-log DP-aggregated; per-user query NEVER cross-tenant linked
Right-to-be-forgotten cascade + signed proof-of-erasure via owned supply-chain signing gates (transitional signing tooling behind ports, ADR-0039 lineage)
ads: Singleton ad-gate as the only sourcing service into ads from tenant data (per docs/PRIVACY-PROGRAM.md §2.2.4)
Per-class data boundary enforced at runtime (HARD_DENY classes never enter auction features)
DP / k-anonymity wrappers on all aggregate exports

continuous_control_monitoring.statement: Per docs/COMPLIANCE-MATRIX.md, every control has an evidence cadence tracked by planned advisory lane governance-control-monitoring. Failures emit EVT-CONTROL-EVIDENCE-MISSING and trigger a runbook.
